name: Moonchild
ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.
drunk_or_poisoned: Checked at night: if drunk or poisoned at night, nobody dies even if chosen while sober; if sober at night, the curse kills even if the choice was made while drunk.

rulings.text: The Moonchild must choose shortly after learning of its death; deliberately skipping is cheating.
If killed again later, the Moonchild chooses again.
The Goon dies if it was good when chosen, regardless of its alignment at night.
If executed but surviving (e.g. Pacifist), the Moonchild makes no choice.
Protected players (Sailor, Fool, Tea Lady, Innkeeper) do not die from the curse.

test_scenarios.name: Good target dies
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Moonchild, Bob Exorcist, Carol Pukka.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is killed; in the morning she chooses Bob.

test_scenarios.name: Evil target survives
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is executed and chooses Eve.

test_scenarios.name: Poisoned at night
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Moonchild chooses Bob (good) by day; that night Eve Poisoner poisons Alice.

test_scenarios.name: Dies twice
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is eaten and chooses Eve (evil); later regurgitated, eaten again, and chooses Bob (good).
